execution.run: Single selected mock/text task, one trial/attempt, uncached and graded: adaptLocalUnit -> prepareInlineAttempt -> executeAttemptWithRequest; historical aggregate writer and lifecycle retained.
execution.runner adapt: Exact captured mock/text eval/task -> AdaptLocal -> Parse/admit; no discovery, source rewriting, runtime construction or execution. Native adaptation is rejected: runner native execution requires explicit paid-execution consent.
execution.runner run: Versioned request -> Parse/admit -> ExecuteInlineAttempt -> prepareInlineAttempt -> executeAttemptWithRequest; runner terminal writer, not historical results.
execution.serve: POST /api/v1/runner/run uses runner run's service; terminals persisted under results/.runner and inspected by Lab on Linux/macOS. Other platforms explicitly return publication_failed infrastructure_failure with retained execution evidence; safe private publication is unsupported, never silently reported as persisted.

historical_inputs.eval: Omitted/default 1.4 and supported 1.x minors remain readable; captured 1.x text profile requires explicit disabled_skills [*]. Scenario 2.0 has no ambient skill discovery.
historical_inputs.task: Unversioned historical task YAML; enabled omitted/null inherit true, false is not executable; timeout omitted/null inherit, explicit zero rejected; command_mocks null inherits, [] is an explicit unsupported override.
historical_inputs.results: Historical 1.x EvaluationOutcome readers retained unchanged; current aggregate writers emit 1.7. Runner 1.0 kind is explicitly not EvaluationOutcome.
historical_inputs.snapshot_sidecar: Independent historical snapshot/evidence families remain accepted by their own readers, never converted into runner success.

not_single_unit_execution.run: Multiple resolved tasks/trials/attempts, baseline, concurrent, CSV, caching, snapshots, execution-only, hooks, skills, files, dependency mocks and multiturn retain historical orchestration. Native local modes retain the legacy shared SDK lifecycle rather than silently acquiring the runner's request-owned cleanup/consent policy.
not_single_unit_execution.dev: Iterative/batch optimization; no exact single-unit mapping.
not_single_unit_execution.compare: Paired/multiple observations; no exact single-unit mapping.
not_single_unit_execution.compare-collect: Controlled baseline/candidate collection with independent frozen evidence; not one runner unit.
not_single_unit_execution.compare-plan: Offline paired collection planning; not execution.
not_single_unit_execution.assure: Frozen multi-artifact assurance assessment; not one runner unit.
not_single_unit_execution.quality: LLM judge with skill-file loading and structured quality report; unsupported inline text profile, historical command unchanged.
not_single_unit_execution.suggest: LLM artifact authoring with skill-file loading and optional writes; unsupported runner result/side-effect mapping, historical command unchanged.
not_single_unit_execution.models: SDK model catalog discovery; not task execution.
not_single_unit_execution.adversarial: Multi-arm fault execution; no exact single-unit mapping.
not_single_unit_execution.grade: Offline regrading of historical evidence, not execution.
not_single_unit_execution.replay: Historical snapshot/artifact operation, not a runner invocation.

other_local_surfaces.gate: Recorded evaluation policy assessment, not execution.
other_local_surfaces.coverage: Static skill/eval coverage inspection, not execution.
other_local_surfaces.session: Historical NDJSON log inspection, not execution.
other_local_surfaces.mcp-mock: Dependency-mock service/configuration, not one runner unit.
other_local_surfaces.command-mock: Command-mock service/configuration, not one runner unit.

unsupported_runner_mapping: Hard admission error, no engine construction. Continue waza run, or choose one exact unit, inline prompt/resources, explicitly disable ambient skills and use builtin text checks. Never infer success from unavailable historical evidence.
